title: Added complete Hindi (hi_IN) translation for Ghostty interface.
body:
This pull request adds a complete Hindi (hi_IN) translation for the Ghostty interface.
All user-visible strings have been translated from English to pure, easy-to-understand Hindi, while maintaining clarity for technical terms.

The goal of this localization is to make Ghostty more accessible and friendly for Hindi-speaking users and developers across India.
The translation preserves key technical terminology (like Terminal, Command, Configuration) while using natural Hindi phrasing for better readability.

Key additions:

Added new file: po/hi_IN.UTF-8.po

Translated all interface strings in natural, modern Hindi

This helps bring Ghostty closer to its growing global community by adding official Hindi language support 🇮🇳✨
